status: Published parameters and control populations declared; flow initialization under verification before application comparisons.
viscosity_policy: Vary constant dynamic viscosity alone; freeze density and expansion at 348.15 K. Preserve the original thermal conductivities and volumetric capacities.
physical_scope: Buoyancy-only, laminar, axisymmetric sensitivity assessment with frozen transport properties. These published assessment parameters leave the original oil identity unspecified.
controls: All six previously frozen fields and all subsequent outcomes remain included.
pilot: Nominal steady target at level 0; verify the computed-flow baseline before the coupled solve.

solver.flow: P2/P1 axisymmetric Navier-Stokes; damped Newton with a verified Jacobian and sparse direct inner solves. The initial Picard and direct Newton attempts remain in the pilot records.
solver.thermal: Original P1 operator and streamline stabilization; mass-lumped source and storage
solver.coupling: Segregated flow and thermal solves; temperature relaxation 0.5; final momentum rebuilt at updated temperature

initialization.viscosity: Start at 64 times the physical viscosity; adaptive logarithmic reductions; retain every rejected step; at most 80 stages with at most 30 Newton iterations each; final acceptance requires the physical viscosity.
initialization.pseudo_time: Separate initialization control at physical viscosity: start at 0.001 s, adapt increments using Newton work, at most 200 steps and 12 Newton iterations per step; verify the original steady residual independently.
initialization.line_search: Armijo factor 1e-4, halving up to 24 times, using the exact quadratic residual along the Newton direction; independent matrix assembly supplies the final equation check.
initialization.stagnation: Stop a Newton attempt after six steps with damping below 1e-4 and less than one percent change in the momentum residual.
initialization.status: Pilot choice of initialization remains open. Freeze it before the selected-control application comparisons.

solver.quadrature: Positive degree-eight triangle rule for axisymmetric P2 momentum; unchanged degree-five thermal integration.

convection_forms.skew: Add one half of div(v)*v; verify the kinetic-energy flux identity. See 10.1016/j.jcp.2017.02.039. Both forms represent the same incompressible continuous equation.

grad_div.coefficient: grad_div_scale * inlet velocity * radial domain width
grad_div.scope: Consistent discrete momentum stabilization; physical parameters and saved source controls remain fixed.

boundary_conditions: Original inlet velocity 0.027 m/s, including inlet corner values; no slip on remaining fluid walls and interfaces; natural viscous-pressure traction at outlet interior; original thermal boundary and sources.
initial_flow: Computed steady baseline with feedback disabled, at the same viscosity setting.
accuracy_scope: Discrete coupled-equation convergence and conservation are distinct from physical and temporal resolution. Report violations and unresolved resolution separately.
timing: Forward-assessment cost only; preparation and computed-flow baseline reported separately. No deflation or optimization speedup claim.
